body:
Fictional Financial Standards Board (FFSB) has published notice FFSB-SN-2026-529 (Encryption of customer data at rest). It takes effect on 2026-10-26.

Can Compliance work out which platforms are in scope and whether we meet the new encryption requirement?
signature:
Joanna Lowther
Analyst, Compliance
Harbourline Mutual Finance Ltd
subject: Regulatory update for review
